about: NPU job queue (owner 2026-11-26: the NPU should always be tasked). Run with tools\.venv-npu\Scripts\python -I tools\npu\run_queue.py; state in tools/npu/out/queue-state.json. Jobs with approved=false need the owner's OK (downloads, installs) and are skipped until then. Local-model output is a drafting aid only: it never reaches the phone unchecked.

jobs.note: built 2026-11-26: code pairs number-vs-number disagreements across two docs under one topic; the model only adds an advisory CONFLICT/DIFFERENT/UNSURE verdict. For Claude's review, never the phone.

jobs.title: Verbatim key-quote index over the whole corpus (~10,100 pages) on the NPU: the 1-3 most load-bearing sentences per page (key instruction, number/dose/frequency/temperature, safety warning), KEPT ONLY when they are a word-for-word substring of the page (fail-closed; paraphrase is dropped). A card-sourcing / retrieval AID ONLY — never shown to a user, never treated as true; everything that ships is still quote-checked and reviewed. source_packs only covers 40 targeted questions; this indexes the whole corpus. Reads tools/kit/.textcache. Resumable. Runs after conflict-scan.
